summary:
Canonical work-board owns common organization/product coordination, recovery, capacity, qualification, delivery, telemetry and progress instructions. Necessary recovery/routine/handoff entrypoints are dependency-closed in Drivers; historical work-programme instructions and helper paths are finite compatibility redirects, not a second planner. Roadmap remains the legitimate native field, roadmap-telemetry the external command, and persisted programme wire/helper identities retain explicit compatibility. Strategic plans retain full technical acceptance/history without duplicate current-status or closure upkeep. Normal Codex routing is gpt-6.1-sol medium and best is gpt-6-astra high; unsupported exact routing refuses dispatch rather than silently substituting. No dispatch, fixed wave or extra approval loop is mandatory. Ordinary source uses one exact independent review and required CI, with actual changed assertions run early and final compatible base assembled before costly qualification.

The selected organization successor adds binding5/schema3 with exactly one Work level SINGLE_SELECT field and exact Outcome/Delivery field/option identities, inspection/3 bounded native hierarchy and integrator-observations/2 hierarchy-digest joins. Outcome preserves the complete owning promise, including undecomposed installed, restart, rollback and participant requirements. Only explicitly enrolled Delivery identities may be selected; linked unenrolled children remain visible and unschedulable. Missing or partial relevant relationships, issue/node mismatches in either direction, contradictions or cycles remain scoped Unknown. A parent's incomplete child coverage withholds parent rollup but does not automatically block an independently complete child. Parent/sibling Blocked is not an automatic prerequisite; action-relevant native/plan prerequisites remain binding. Original owner/slice/attempt/PR/head continuation consumes no fresh implementation demand and never creates a duplicate assignment or reservation.

The authenticated private enrollment-payload/v1 issue/node/Roadmap triples and public commitment/v3 are unchanged. A private binding carries a32-byte nonce and canonical padded Base64 of exact UTF-8 payload bytes. Commitment hashing retains the domain/NUL, nonce, unsigned eight-byte big-endian length and original bytes, not a reserialization. Public enrollment remains exactly schema plus digest, with no public identities or private-derived fingerprints. Binding/payload bounds remain256KiB/128KiB with depth16 and closed duplicate/unknown/missing/encoding refusals. Protected authentication precedes selected source reads; final protected-main/blob/digest currentness follows slow inspection and remains before Observation writes or Verified no-ops. Offline pair construction shares the runtime validator, preserves exact payload bytes and exclusive durable original outputs, and establishes preparation only. Binding4/schema2/inspection2 and product3/schema1 retain their actual qualified behavior; old observation provenance remains admitted, while the new canonical path needs a qualified successor. No runtime model fallback or silent selector/binding/enrollment transition follows from loading instructions.

Owning declarations retain exactly Owner, Done when, Current deliverable, Next action, Blocked on and Acceptance evidence. Mixed/duplicate/ambiguous fields remain gaps; fenced examples never supply declarations. Exact None alone declares no current work. Non-PR and mixed genuine current-work declarations remain visible and require the existing exact scoped current-deliverable prerequisite, joined to fresh body/source/owner/slice/attempt/native PR facts. Arbitrary history and Next action never manufacture a current owner or PR. Full native membership reconciliation, relevant original uncertain reservations, intake and remaining-after-active capacity remain independent determining facts.

Inspection exposes raw scoped acceptance fields, bounded parent/direct-child identities, completeness/digest, native state reason/date and explicit unverified acceptance. COMPLETED is distinct from NOT_PLANNED or DUPLICATE. Read-only progress reports native completion dates and scoped delivery evidence separately from parent promises; missing relationship metadata is Unknown, never complete empty coverage, and counts are not percentages. One accountable owner reconciles authorized native issue/Status/evidence effects and parent remaining assertions, retaining partial effects after interruption. No legacy automatic parent climb or second acceptance ledger is introduced. Merged source, all children closed, deferred requirements and healthy Observation refresh cannot satisfy missing parent scope. Refresh writes no Work level, Status, Track, Roadmap or closure intent.

The maintained typed migration writer adds an optional exact Work level plan through version2 prepared/readback forms; legacy forms remain unchanged. Creation is one exact typed effect followed by correlated independent field/option readback, then only explicitly selected absent classifications. Equal values are no-ops; conflicting/unreadable values and unexpected same-name fields refuse. Native membership is not enrollment. Selected existing view IDs, layout, column order and orthogonal grouping/sorting settings remain preserved; only explicit Work level column append is allowed. The existing All items identity/name cannot be renamed or filtered to bypass the unfiltered population view. Compare-before-write is not CAS; the existing finite participating single-writer window, request bounds, original durable journals and independent readback remain mandatory. Uncertain sends never replay or become inferred no effect.

Coherent0.107 source includes the exact prospective release profile for promoted0.106 predecessor and journal25; its availability and publication need fresh operational admission. The sole canonical skill becomes normally discoverable while other explicit-only variants retain policy. Source staging validates the actual packaged dependency/link closure and ProductBoard materialization derives driver membership from that manifest. Package existence or metadata does not prove runtime-selected discovery: selected absolute paths, project overrides and the loaded runtime catalog require real consumer evidence. Source delivery, publication, installed instruction discovery, executing caller qualification, native field/classification/enrollment/views and consumer adoption are separate gates. Source delivery4677 cannot close outcome4641's installed/restart/rollback promise. Accepted prior cutover and published/installed versions retain their own scope. Original restore/compiler/fixture/review failures remain retained; unavailable historical searches are not revived, and439 inherited plus46 later originals remain Unknown/unreleased. This source capture establishes no live mutation, new cutover, performance benefit or installed adoption.
